description: Somos 🌱 Terratrend Explorer 🌎 un equipo entusiasta 👽 que busca transformar datos satelitales de la NASA sobre glaciares, temperatura e incendios forestales, queremos visibilizar el cambio climático en una experiencia educativa e interactiva, también buscamos fomentar e inspirar a nuevas generaciones a explorar y cuidar nuestro planeta con creatividad y datos reales. 🌷
summary: We created an interactive, educational web platform for exploring and researching environmental changes in Peru, utilizing NASA data and remote sensing. We developed an educational web prototype that allows users to explore satellite evidence and climate data from NASA, thereby enhancing the interpretation of environmental changes in Peru. We visualized critical areas using a Leaflet map and accessed dynamic air temperature (T2M) data via the NASA POWER API. We also integrated interactive quizzes covering glaciers, temperature, and fires that provide feedback and include links to Worldview, FIRMS, and POWER. Furthermore, we implemented a temporal comparison of the Quelccaya glacier, encouraging observation, hypothesis formulation, and the use of verifiable evidence.
details: Terra Trend Explorer is a project that maps climate data by location across Peru. It displays variations in temperature, glacier status, and fire incidents, providing forecasts based on data from NASA satellites. These predictions can help in the prevention of natural disasters. The project was developed using the Python programming language and the platform CodePen.io. It is both creative and innovative, utilizing maps, statistics, and educational digital tools to facilitate dynamic understanding and learning. In its development, we took into account the El Niño phenomenon and the concerning climate changes currently affecting our country, Peru.
